purpose: Retain screen recognition while reducing full PNG-decode + OCR + contour wall time; no OS capture, model or action claims.
equivalence_gate: Persistent screen ordered UIElement text, bounds, confidence and all UI candidates equal screen subprocess for every measured frame/repetition; original pixels unchanged.
accuracy_gate: Unique-frame text F1 strictly greater than BOTH native English and native bilingual; candidate ordered text/bounds/integer confidence and all contour candidates exactly equal frozen screen subprocess on every measurement. Precision, recall and rectangle TP/FP/FN fully reported; no mandatory P/R non-inferiority gate.
speed_gate: All warm repetitions included. Full-frame median at least 10% lower than each of the other three arms; per-frame persistent median not over5% slower than screen. p95/max/slow frames retained.
cold_rule: Three fresh-engine first-frame measurements per arm reported separately, including creation/loading; warmup first call per arm retained separately and never described as warm speed.
warm_rule: Each frame/arm gets one retained warmup. Each of two predetermined independent process batches then runs 10 interleaved paired repeats per frame/arm; rotate by frame+repeat and reverse odd repeats. No slow records excluded.
amendment_reason: Before any holdout inference: Root finalized F1 superiority to BOTH native English and bilingual arms; precision/recall tradeoffs must be reported rather than added as hard non-inferiority gates. Clarify each-frame warmup, exact screen rectangle outputs, pins and full timing scope. No result-dependent threshold changes.
cold_scope: Three fresh engine first-frame calls per arm. Includes engine construction/lazy library/model initialization and full processing, excludes engine teardown and application CLI/YAML startup; OS page-cache state uncontrolled. Cold is reported separately without a speed pass requirement.
full_timing_scope: PNG decode + pixel-preservation snapshot + same screen preprocessing/scaling + real CPU OCR + coordinate/text handling + contour/UI extraction. Perf-counter start/end and image SHA retained. No OS capture/model/input.
gate_source: Root explicit instruction 2026-10-28 and review/acceptance_contract.md; review contract P/R requirement superseded by this explicit decision before evaluation.
